row.title: Every fleet property is read daily for search and AI discoverability
row.body: FINDABLE-1 (Rowan 2026-11-25): no Zenodo or DOIs. Reach comes from open standards: robots, sitemap, llms.txt, meta, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD and feeds on every property in the directory, read daily by foundation/findable.py; gaps become Q-FIND items and feeds are pinged to the WebSub hub. Tests: tests/foundation/test_findable.py 4 pass.
